result.paraphrase: XPG GAMMIX S50 model AGAMMIXS50-1TT-C is a consumer internal SSD in the M.2 2280 form factor, with 1TB of 3D TLC memory and a PCI-Express 4.0 x4 interface. Performance specs list up to 4700 MBps sequential read on ATTO, 5000 MBps on CDM (QD32-T1), and 4100 MBps on AS SSD; sequential write reaches 4200 MBps on ATTO, 4400 MBps on CDM (QD32-T1), and 3700 MBps on AS SSD. It delivers up to 750,000 IOPS for both 4KB random read and write, has an MTBF of 1,700,000 hours, includes a heatsink, and features PCIe 4.0 support, NVMe 1.3, advanced LDPC ECC, SLC caching with DRAM cache buffer, and AES 256-bit encryption. Power use is 50 mW idle and 0.8W active; operating temperature is 0°C to +70°C, storage temperature is -40°C to +85°C, shock resistance is 1500G / 0.5 ms, and its dimensions are 6.10mm high, 22.00mm wide, 80.00mm deep, with a weight of 12.00g. First available on October 07, 2019.
